From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — Aurelia Therapeutics

Hi Carlos / Aurelia IT team —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. This thread tracks the access-control-specific handoff so we can get SSO, SCIM, IP allowlisting, and service account provisioning scheduled and completed before your pilot on 2027-09-01. Internal folks copied are the implementation and security leads.

High-level asks for this phase (please reply in-thread with attachments where possible):
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) and preferred NameID format (email / persistent)
- SCIM attribute mapping preferences (we expect: userName, externalId, active, displayName, emails[type=work], groups) — see attached template
- IP allowlist ranges for your egress -> we will whitelist both our hosted endpoints and Dedicated IPs if you provide CIDR list
- Any org policies that must be enforced (e.g., restrict to company domain, employeeType enforcement)
- Service account ownership: name, intended scope, token rotation cadence

Attachments I’m including from our side: redwood-service-account-scope-guide.pdf and a proposed scim_mapping_proposed.csv (placeholder) — please replace with your canonical mapping.

Next steps after we have the metadata and IP ranges: 1) implement SCIM test sync to staging, 2) validate SSO login flow in staging, 3) confirm service account ACLs and rotate keys, 4) production cutover & post-cutover validation window.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday (2027-08-04) whether the IdP metadata and IP list are available? If not, let us know a target date.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior CS Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-service-account-scope-guide.pdf (pdf), scim_mapping_proposed.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Enterprise access handoff: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, service accounts — Aurelia Therapeutics

Thanks Rishi — adding a few implementation notes from the implementation team side:

1) SAML / SSO
- We support both email (transient/unspecified) and persistent NameIDs; for enterprise rollouts we recommend using persistent NameID or email with subject-confirmed match.
- Required assertions we will map: name, email, groups. Optional: employeeType, manager. If you plan to assert employeeType, tell us the exact string values so we can map to SCIM userType if desired.

2) SCIM
- Our SCIM endpoint supports Groups v2 and incremental sync (filter parameter). We will need an initial full-sync window (we typically run during off-hours).
- For group sync: please indicate whether "all_employees" is modelled as a SCIM group or derived via attribute (employeeType=employee). If you prefer group-based access control, include group id mappings in the CSV.

3) Service accounts and tokens
- Suggested service account naming convention: aurelia-redwood-integration@redwood (owner: Aurelia IT).
- Token lifetime: recommend short-lived tokens (90 days) with rotation. We can support rotating tokens and support a pre-rotation grace window for cutovers.

4) IP allowlist
- To support both hosted API and Dedicated fallbacks, provide both external egress ranges and any corporate NAT ranges. We will provide a CIDR template afterwards.

I'll pick up the SCIM mapping work once we have the final CSV. Will schedule a 30-minute implementation window for the staging sync once Carlos confirms times.

—Monica
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

- NameID: email (we will assert eduPersonPrincipalName for certain partners but email is the stable field for Redwood).
- We will assert employeeType: values (ft, contractor, temp). Please map "ft" -> employee, contractors -> contractor role.
- IP ranges attached: 18.196.32.0/21, 34.120.0.0/16 (these are our public NAT pools); we will add a connector-specific private range for Dedicated if required.

Service account: we propose creating aurelia-redwood-integration@aureliahealth.com as a managed service principal in Azure AD. Token rotation policy will be 60 days for now. If Redwood needs longer for migration, Carlos consider letting us know.

Hi all —

I uploaded a proposed SCIM CSV mapping to the shared drive and attached a copy here (scim_mapping_proposed.csv). Implementation notes and decisions captured:
- We will map Aurelia's employeeType values (ft, contractor, temp) to SCIM: employee, contractor, temporary.
- Primary identifier: emails[type=work] -> userName. We will not use externalId for initial sync to keep the source-of-truth in Aurelia AD.
- Groups: we recommend syncing group membership for "pilot_users" and "admins" only. This avoids syncing noise across all AD groups. If Aurelia prefers full-group sync, please indicate by EOD Monday.
- Org policy: Aurelia requested enforced domain restriction (only @aureliahealth.com allowed). We will implement an org policy in staging that blocks non-domain accounts from successful SSO/SCIM creation. Expect a short validation failure for contractors who sign in via partner emails — we will handle via group exceptions.

Next steps from implementation team:
- Monica to schedule a 30-min staging sync window (preferred: 2027-08-10 23:00-23:30 PDT)
- Jonas to provision a temporary service account in staging once the aurelia-redwood-integration principal exists. Jonas, I put the ticket in Jira (RDW-8472) for provisioning details.

Attachments: scim_mapping_proposed.csv

—Neha
Implementation Engineer, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround and the artifacts. Quick summary and owners so we have a clean handoff: 

1) IdP metadata (Carlos) — received and verified for staging (Monica).
2) IP ranges (Carlos) — received; Monica will apply to staging allowlist and provide final CIDR entries for production.
3) SCIM mapping (Neha) — reviewed; Neha to run initial full sync in staging during the window on 2027-08-10 23:00 PDT.
4) Service account (Jonas) — Jonas to provision aurelia-redwood-integration in staging and attach minimal scopes: SCIM:Write, SSO:Read. Token rotation set to 60 days per Aurelia request; we will keep a migration exemption window.
5) Org policy (Monica/Neha) — enforce domain-only signups in staging and document contractor exception flow.

Open questions / blockers (action items):
- Carlos: confirm whether you want contractors to be created in SCIM or only represented via groups (reply in-thread).
- Aurelia Security: any additional audit logging requirements for SCIM user writes? We can enable change-tracking and export logs to your SIEM if required.

Once we complete the staging sync and SSO smoke tests, we'll schedule the production cutover (target week of 2027-09-01). I'll create the post-cutover validation checklist and share it to the drive.

Thanks — I’ll update the Jira RDW-8472 with the confirmed windows and closure notes.

Rishi
Senior CS Manager
Redwood Inference
